summary.en: Launched in July 2020 by Taipei Medical University with BE Capital (比翼資本), described as Taiwan's first international-caliber university biomedical accelerator. It uses a venture-studio model (TMU X BE) co-investing roughly US$100,000 per selected startup, draws on TMU's six affiliated hospitals for clinical validation, and focuses on digital health, AI and medical devices. By recent batches it had accelerated around 100 domestic and international startups and invested in 8.
